msg_no_slides: No slides added yet - use the search field on the left to find a snippet, page, blog post or product.
msg_confirm_delete_slideshow: Really delete this slideshow and all its slides?
msg_source_missing: Record was deleted - remove this slide.
hint_slug: Used in the shortcode as key=..., e.g. [plugin=swiperjs]key=hero-homepage[/plugin]. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only, must be unique.
hint_height: e.g. 400px or 60vh - leave empty for automatic height.
hint_accent_color: A Bootstrap theme color name (e.g. primary, danger, dark) - automatically follows your theme's own color. For Tailwind or other themes, enter a real color value instead, e.g. #4f46e5 or rgb(79,70,229). Leave empty for Swiper's default color.
hint_theme_provides_swiper: Enable if the active theme already loads Swiper.js and its CSS in the header/footer. When disabled, the plugin automatically loads its own bundled Swiper build for every slideshow. The slide layout styles are separate from this (see below).
hint_layout: Applies to every slide of this slideshow. Individual slides can use a different layout in the slide list on the right.
label_theme_provides_layout_css: Theme provides its own slide layout styles
hint_theme_provides_layout_css: Enable if your theme styles the .swiperjs-* classes itself - the plugin then no longer outputs its own slide CSS. Markup and the complete CSS to copy: see the link below.
